data.gender_notes: Raghdiyyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Raghd', which means contentment, delight, satisfaction and pleasure. It is a beautiful name for a baby girl, signifying joy and happiness. The name Raghdiyyah carries the meaning “Contentment, Delight, Satisfaction” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Raghdiyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody contentment, delight, satisfaction and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies a deep sense of inner peace and contentment. It is a name that is often given to babies who are born with a natural sense of joy and happiness.
data.etymology: Raghdiyyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Contentment, Delight, Satisfaction.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raghdiyyah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
